reason: Alloy fields are lexically nested in signatures; global interleaved owner order cannot round-trip through that syntax.
rule: BLOCK_SUPPORTED module.fields must equal concatenation, in module.signatures order, of its per-owner subsequences. Preserve within-owner order; do not silently reorder a submitted complete candidate. Invalid order is deterministic INVALID_DRAFT. Source elaboration naturally emits this order. UI field insertion/reassignment explicitly maintains the grouped array; report reorder in draft, never alter accepted history.
node_array: module.nodes is an identity-indexed forest registry, so its array storage order is not presentation semantics. Ordered body roots, child slots and call arguments determine expression occurrence order. Structural round-trip compares those ordered trees modulo declared ID bijection; it does not require reconstructing flat registry order. Other declaration arrays retain their documented order.
scope: Additional presentation guard; all 237 existing registered claims retained. No change to SQL routing, type rules, semantics, solver budgets, canonical embedding policy or commercial status.
tests: Accept empty and multiple-owner grouped fields; reject interleaved owner order on server and browser complete-candidate check.
Round-trip grouped per-owner order with distinct fieldIDs/ranges/multiplicities; shuffled nodes registry does not change ordered syntax tree.
UI adds/moves field only by explicit draft transition; source printing retains group/within-owner order.
production_gate: Do not implement this additional acceptance guard until exact Lean check and six council approvals. Existing incomplete engine stays unavailable; unrelated preapproved implementation may proceed.
